objective: The contradiction classifier compares only the first number, so years and percentages hide real conflicts. server/services/research/contradictions.ts ~L139 takes leftNumbers[0] and rightNumbers[0], and the unit regex ~L52 has no word boundary after the unit. 'In 2024 the market was $5 billion' vs '... $8 billion' is RESOLVED_BY_CONTEXT, 'grew 12% to $5 billion' vs '12% to $9 billion' likewise, and '5 months' is read as 5 million. CLAUDE.md §14: incompatible figures are never averaged and a real disagreement must be classified. Fix: \b after the unit; drop year-like 4-digit tokens (1900-2100, no unit); tag quantities by kind (percent vs magnitude); compare same-kind quantities pairwise and return RESOLVED_BY_CONTEXT only when every comparable pair agrees.
expectedOutcome: Numeric contradictions are detected across all comparable quantities, not just the first number.

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/contradictionQuantities.test.ts: the $5bn vs $8bn pair sharing a year returns DIRECT_FACTUAL_CONFLICT.
'5 months' is not scaled to millions, and identical figures with the same year still return RESOLVED_BY_CONTEXT.
Existing contradiction and replan tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
